create_mechanized.ponder.botania/mana_ma: Automatic Agglomeration Plate
The Rotational Agglomeration Complex (R.A.C) can handle all your terrasteel needs.
And terrasteel will appear in the R.A.C.
Animation and craft time will scale with rotation speed (higher speed, lower time). If rotation is interrupted mid-crafting recipe progress will be saved.
Be aware that there's a delay between first activation (reaching >FAST speed) and craft start, so you should avoid turning it off and on frequently.
Both T.I.E. and R.A.C. can be connected to Mechanical Arms.
Simply place 1 Terrestrial Item Encapsulator (T.I.E) per item required in range of the R.A.C.
The R.A.C. has a 2 block "radius", including vertically.
Then put the needed items inside the T.I.E.
Make sure you have a mana source linked to the R.A.C,
and that the R.A.C is spinning at least at FAST speed.
If it's working, you'll know.
The items will then be consumed.
A little animation will play.
Beware of Encapsulator Overload!
The R.A.C. will search for T.I.E. regardless of line of sight.
This means that a T.I.E. might be in range of more R.A.C / T.R.S. simultaneously.
If that happens, the T.I.E. will become overloaded, and won't be able to provide crafting materials.
If a T.I.E. becomes overloaded mid-recipe, the active one will be finished, but the next won't start.
Infusing items with mana using a Mana Spout
The Mana Spout can handle all recipes a Mana Pool can.
Simply fill it with mana, using a spreader or anything else
Then put the item you want to infuse in below it.
You need either a belt or a depot.
If you have a pool with a spark on it.
And the Mana Spout also has one.
Then the spout will automatically refill when out of mana, if a recipe is in progress.
Handling infusion catalysts
Some recipes might need a block under the pool to work.
You can achieve the same behaviour by replacing the block under the depot / belt.
Industrial Elven Trade
The Trading Rift Stabilizer (T.R.S.) allows you to automate trading with Elves
A little animation will play.
And all outputs with appear on the relative D.S.I.E.
Same rules of the R.A.C. apply, those being craft speed, recipe saving, and start up delay.
Be aware that every time the rift shuts down and re-starts, it will consume mana, just like an alfheim portal would.
Both D.S.I.E., T.I.E. and T.R.S. can be connected to Mechanical Arms.
Simply place 1 Terrestrial Item Encapsulator (T.I.E) per item required in range of the T.R.S.
And also place 1 Dimensionally Stable Item Encapsulator (D.S.I.E) per output in range of the T.R.S.
Then put the needed items inside the T.I.E.
Make sure you have a mana pool nearby,
With a natura pylon above, (botania and ponder don't like each other, trust that there is one)
and that the T.R.S. is spinning at least at FAST speed.
If it's working, you'll know.
The items will then be consumed.
Beware of Encapsulator Overload!
The T.R.S will search for T.I.E. and D.S.I.E. regardless of line of sight.
This means that a D.S.I.E. / T.I.E. might be in range of more R.A.C / T.R.S. simultaneously.
If that happens, the D.S.I.E. / T.I.E. will become overloaded, and won't be able to provide crafting materials.
If a D.S.I.E. / T.I.E. becomes overloaded mid-recipe, the active one will be finished, but the next won't start.
create_mechanized.ponder.tag.botania/man: Components that interact with Botania's mana
Components that interact with Tinkers' Construct
create_mechanized.ponder.tconstruct/melt: Heat the Seared Melter, the Create Low-Heated way.
You can use Basic Burners to heat your melter.
The efficiency will change based on the Burner's Heat level.
Smouldering and Fading Basic Burners will provide little to no heat, they can't even melt most basic metals.
Kindled Basic Burners will provide as much heat as a bucket of Lava while active.
Seething Basic Burners will provide 2.2x the heat a bucket of Lava while active.
All Heat level are considered fluids, and as such can interact with all Fluid based constructs.
Burners are theoretically infinite, as long as they are powered.
Heat the Seared Melter, the Create way.
You can use Blaze Burners to heat your melter.
The efficiency will change based on the Burner's Heat level.
Smouldering and Fading Blaze Burners will provide little to no heat, they can't even melt most basic metals.
Kindled Blaze Burners will provide as much heat as a bucket of Lava while active.
Seething Blaze Burners will provide 2.2x the heat a bucket of Lava while active.
All Heat level are considered fluids, and as such can interact with all Fluid based constructs.
Burners are theoretically infinite, as long as they are powered.
create_mechanized.ponder.tconstruct/sear: Heat the Seared Smeltery, the Create way.
You can use a Seared Burner to heat your smeltery.
The efficiency will change based on the Burner's Heat level.
The Seared Burner takes the place of the tank, it not suggested having any other tank / burner with it.
It takes any fuel a Blazing Burner can take, including super-heating ones.
You can right click it with a wrench to cycle the seared style, to fit it with your smeltery.
